about: Every image and sound in the passage, where it came from, what it does, and what was looked at and not used.

used.what: her recorded reading of DJ TURN ME UP, 661.0-674.8 s on the suite clock
used.role: the call: the line the passage exists for; word times by faster-whisper (small)

used.what: Sound And The Story (1956), 38.8 s clip: a hand turning console knobs, a disc, LOUD/SOFT groove diagrams
used.role: already matched to this line by the cineosis cels cut (patch P07-006); here it is (1) the console she touches, (2) what plays on the canopy, (3) the inset answer, (4) the archive sound the knob raises
used.treatment: console: one frame at 3.75 s, upscaled 4x, meter needle painted out (RETOUCHED); canopy: perspective-mapped, sepia grade, LED texture over it; inset: untouched frames 0-1.75 s

used.what: WYGWYL poem_07 AI video, keyframe 60: the LED canopy street
used.role: the set; its own ADE20K ceiling class is the screen surface; its person class is the crowd
used.treatment: held still (not the moving video), upscaled to 1920, two crowd figures cut out and the area under them painted

used.what: generated image of cardboard puppet parts
used.role: the POET puppet: head, torso, skirt, legs, far arm and scroll hand, near upper arm and forearm
used.treatment: cut by build_assets.py, pivots measured on debug_sheet.jpg

used.what: generated image of one pinching hand, made with the parts sheet as reference
used.role: the near hand; the sheet's hand was painted over a notepad and could not be separated
used.treatment: cut, scaled 0.2, pinch gap kept open

drawn: meter needle (boils on twos, on its own layer)
synthesised: knob detent clicks (one per 15 deg, from the knob track)

inspected_not_used.title: Sound And The Story (1956), second clip (P07-009)
inspected_not_used.why: the disc and groove material is already in da69b1ba at the right time; one source per passage keeps the ledger short

inspected_not_used.title: Eagle Has Landed: The Flight of Apollo 11 (1969), P04-011
inspected_not_used.why: tested for poem 04: men at a ship's rail at dusk; strong, but no object a puppet can touch; second choice

inspected_not_used.title: Moonwalk One (ca. 1970), P04-012
inspected_not_used.why: 53 s, mostly launch crowds; would be a screen join only

inspected_not_used.title: Moonwalk One (ca. 1970), P07-004
inspected_not_used.why: the only locally cached poem 07 clip; no relation to the line's action

inspected_not_used.title: Gouda (1923), P06-006
